paragraph: I **donned** a hat yesterday, because it was very cold. He **donned** a business suit. He **donned** his trademark glasses.
english: to put on clothing

paragraph: I heard my mother singing in the **shower**. I'm going to go take a **shower**. Can I use your **shower**?
english: device for bathing
arabicDesc: مثال: سمعت والدتي تغني في الحمام.

other.meaning: To spray with (a specified liquid) (followed by with) (verb)

paragraph: His failure is, in a **manner**, our failure too. I find her **manner** a little hard to take. Do you suppose I placed it in that **manner**?
english: mode of action
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: طريقة

paragraph: **Marine** plants grow on the sea bed. Speeding boats are dangerous to **marine** life and people. **Marine** species are moving to new locations toward cooler waters.
english: of or pertaining to the sea
arabicDesc: مثال: النباتات البحرية تنمو في قاع البحر.

paragraph: He has been warned on several **occasions**. I met him on several **occasions**. He made an excuse just to suit the **occasion**.
english: a favorable opportunity
arabicDesc: مثال: قد أُنذِر مرات عديدة.

paragraph: The **dedicated** bike zone is most often at the rear of the train. I want to **dedicate** my life to language learning. Who are you going to **dedicate** the book to?
english: to set apart for a deity or for religious purposes
arabicDesc: مثال: في اكثر الاحيان تكون المنطقة المخصصة للدراجات الهوائية في مؤخرة القطار .

other.meaning: to commit (oneself) to a particular course of thought or action

paragraph: What he says is **brief** and to the point. The game brought them a **brief** moment of joy. Could you give us a **brief** introduction of yourself?
english: of short duration
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: قصير

paragraph: I am certain that he will **quit** his job. If you don't like it, then you can **quit**. If you **quit** your job, you'll be burning your bridges.
english: to give up, stop doing something
arabicDesc: مثال: أنا متأكد أنه سيستقيل من منصبه.

paragraph: My father always speaks in a very **loud** voice. I'll talk to him about the **loud** music. A **loud** noise in the night scared him.
english: of a sound
arabicDesc: مثال: أبي يتكلم دائما بصوت مرتفع جدا.

paragraph: We went up the mountain by **cable** car. The **cable** was sticking out of the wall. A **cable** car is a type of vehicle.
english: a long object used to make a physical connection

paragraph: All I did was **stretch** the truth a little. Let's stop and **stretch** our legs for a bit. The mates chatted with each other at a **stretch**.
english: to lengthen by pulling

other.meaning: to extend one’s limbs or body, for example in order to improve the elasticity the muscles

paragraph: Why did he **accuse** my son? She **accused** me of not writing to her sooner. Have you ever **accused** him of telling lies before his claim?
english: attribute blame to someone
arabicDesc: مثال: لمَ اتّهم إبني؟

paragraph: I did not mean to **disappoint** her. I promise not to **disappoint** you. If I'm not really pregnant, I'm going to be so **disappointed**.
english: to sadden or displease (someone) by underperforming, or by not delivering something promised or hoped for
arabicDesc: مثال: لم أكن أقصد إحباطها.

paragraph: Television is a very important **medium** for giving information. I would class my garden as **medium** in size. Cover and cook over **medium** heat for three minutes.
english: of intermediate size, degree, amount etc

paragraph: **Gender** Studies is a newer department at the university. We must work to close the **gender** pay gap. **Gender** transition is the treatment for a medical condition.
english: synonym of voice (“particular way of inflecting or conjugating verbs”)

other.meaning: identification as a man, a woman, or something else

paragraph: The United States is a **republic**. I have served this great **republic** all my life. He immediately started the next attack on the **republic**.
english: a type of state
arabicDesc: مثال: الولايات المتحدة هي جمهورية.

paragraph: The secret will **emerge** in due course of time. Love begins to **emerge** between the two. When I hold a pen, thoughts **emerge**.
english: to come into view

paragraph: This dog is more **attached** to us than this cat. Please fill out the **attached** job application form. A note was **attached** to the document with a paper clip.
english: to fasten, to join to (literally and figuratively)
arabicDesc: مثال: هذا الكلب أكثر تعلقا بنا من ذا القط.

paragraph: We may not be able to **afford** it. If you can't **afford** a lawyer, one will be provided for you. Can we **afford** to eat here?
english: to incur, stand, or bear without serious detriment, as an act which might under other circumstances be injurious
arabicDesc: مثال: قد لا نتحمل سعره.

paragraph: I may have met him somewhere before, but I can't **recall** where. I can't **recall** a good way to get there. I can't **recall** what my father said to me.
english: to withdraw, retract (one's words etc.)
arabicDesc: مثال: لربما قابلته في مكان ما من قبل و لكني لا أذكر أين.

other.meaning: to call (someone) back to a specific place, station
The action or fact of calling someone or something back (noun)

paragraph: She wants to buy a present for her **boyfriend**. Why did you break up with your last **boyfriend**? My parents don't like my **boyfriend** because he's poor.
english: male friend
arabicDesc: مثال: إنها تريد شراء هدية لصديقها.

other.meaning: male partner in a romantic relationship

paragraph: **Literature** is the future of a nation. She likes reading English **literature**. There is a lot of **literature** on this subject.
english: body of all written works
arabicDesc: مثال: الأدب مستقبل دولة.

paragraph: I think we can find the way back by **ourselves**. We have to do this by **ourselves**. I don't think that we'll be able to solve this problem by **ourselves**.
english: referring to everyone being addressed
arabicDesc: مثال: أعتقد أنه بإمكاننا إيجاد طريق العودة بأنفسنا.

paragraph: What are you doing **Thursday** night? I made a booking over the phone last **Thursday**. The road has been blocked since at least **Thursday**.
english: day of the week
arabicDesc: مثال: ماذا ستفعل يوم الخميس ليلا؟

paragraph: In that area, horses were **typically** a common sight. How much does a high-end computer **typically** cost? A truck **typically** uses more gas than a car.
english: usually; in a typical way

english: happening through bad luck
arabicDesc: مثال: بالأمس قرأت كتاباً للأسف كان مُملاً جداً.

paragraph: I went to bed later than **usual**. She came late as **usual**. He put the key on the table as **usual**.
english: most commonly occurring
arabicDesc: مثال: ذهبت للنوم متأخراً أكثر من العادة.

paragraph: Each **voter** must decide for himself. Are you a registered **voter**? The best argument against democracy is a five-minute conversation with the average **voter**.
english: someone who votes or is entitled to vote
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: ناخب

paragraph: My mother **permitted** me to go to the movies. You are not **permitted** to touch the art. You're not **permitted** to do that without a **permit**.
english: to allow (something) to happen, to give permission for
arabicDesc: مثال: سمحت لي أمي بأن أذهب إلى السينما.

other.meaning: An artifact or document rendering something allowed or legal (noun)

paragraph: My son is now as **tall** as I am. The **tall** man came out of the house. You are **tall**, but he is still **taller**.
english: of a building
arabicDesc: مثال: إبني بنفس طولي حالياً.

paragraph: I haven't eaten since **breakfast** and I'm very hungry. She is in the habit of taking exercise before **breakfast**. Do you usually have tea for **breakfast**?
english: first meal of the day
arabicDesc: مثال: لم آكل مذ أفطرت، وأنا جائع جدا.

paragraph: Why are those people climbing up on the **roof**? I saw a house whose **roof** was red. All her cats are sitting on the **roof** of the car.
english: the cover at the top of a building
arabicDesc: مثال: لماذا يصعد هؤلاء الناس على السقف؟

paragraph: English has become my **favourite** subject. What is your **favourite** animal? This is my **favourite** project.
english: most-liked. (In other words, [person]'s favorite [noun] = the [noun] that [person] likes the most.)
arabicDesc: مثال: أصبحت الإنجليزيّة مادّتي المفضّلة.

paragraph: I wasn't the **drunkest** person at the party. The less I drink, the **drunker** I am. I saw a few **drunks** in the park singing and dancing.
english: intoxicated as a result of excessive alcohol consumption, usually by drinking alcoholic beverages
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: ثمل

other.meaning: One who is intoxicated with alcohol (noun)

paragraph: The **depth** of the river is about ten meters. He reads the novels given to him in **depth**. I was out of my **depth** in that debate.
english: the vertical distance below a surface

paragraph: What would happen if the earth stopped **spinning**? To make a top **spin**, you need a string. The room started to **spin** after I drank too much.
english: to rotate, revolve, gyrate (usually quickly)
arabicDesc: مثال: ماذا سيحدث إن توقفت الأرض عن الدوران؟

paragraph: Does it **bother** you if I smoke? Think whatever you want. Just don't **bother** me with your thinking. I've seen that happen so many times that it doesn't **bother** me anymore.
english: to annoy, to disturb, to irritate
arabicDesc: مثال: ألا تبالي إن دخنت؟

paragraph: Keep your distance from any wild animals you **encounter**. If you **encounter** that man, please inform me immediately. What should I do if I **encounter** a bear?
english: to meet (someone) or find (something), especially unexpectedly
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: لاقى، عثر

other.meaning: A meeting, especially one that is unplanned or unexpected (noun)

paragraph: The **trail** is known by locals. The **trail** headed off in an entirely different direction. There is a **trail** that goes through the forest.
english: route for travel over land
arabicDesc: مثال: يعرف السّكّان المحلّيّون ذلك المسلك.

other.meaning: signs of something/someone has passed previously

paragraph: The door was locked when we **found** it. I just **found** out that my wife cheated on me. Is this the way you have **found** to fight depression?
english: to start an organization
arabicDesc: مثال: وجدنا الباب مقفلا.

paragraph: The nurse cleaned the cut with a little **alcohol**.
english: the substance in drinks such as wine and beer; also used to clean things
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: غول

paragraph: She told me that she wanted a **pet** dog. My **pet** dog was seriously ill. You can **pet** the dog.
english: an animal kept as a companion or otherwise for pleasure, rather than for some practical benefit or use
arabicDesc: مثال: أخبرتني أنها تريد كلباً أليفاً.

paragraph: He didn't move a **muscle**. Skin and **muscles** are soft tissue. I think I've pulled a **muscle** in my leg.
english: a contractile form of tissue which animals use to effect movement
arabicDesc: مثال: لم يتحرك كليا.

paragraph: He changed his mind in **consequence** of the marriage. I'm aware that every choice I make has a **consequence**. I think it is not the cause but the **consequence**.
english: an effect
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: نتيجة

paragraph: She told us not to make a **noise**. I can't bear the **noise** any longer. What's this **noise**? Is it a train?
english: various sounds, usually unwanted
arabicDesc: مثال: طلبت منا ألا نصدر صوتاً.

paragraph: The trade fair recorded record **visitor** numbers this year. A strange atmosphere surrounds the **visitor** in this room. You are our **visitor** number one hundred thousand.
english: someone who visits someone else

paragraph: He was caught reading a **comic** book in class. I've loved **comic** books since I was a kid. He sent me a **comic** book from Germany.
english: a comedian
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: كوميك، كتاب رسوم، هزلية

paragraph: You seem to be on a very **tight** schedule. I like to feel his body **tight** against mine. I bought it, even though it was too **tight**.
english: firmly held together

english: a room or set of rooms
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: حجرة

paragraph: **Farmers** work in the fields. **Farmers** work on the land. The **farmer** uses a different tool for each task.
english: person who works the land and/or who keeps livestock
arabicDesc: مثال: يعمل الفلاحون في الحقل.

paragraph: My mother is making a **cake** for my father. Could I get a little piece of that **cake**? Cut the **cake** with a knife.
english: type of sweet dessert
arabicDesc: مثال: تعد أمي كعكة لأبي.

paragraph: The room was so full of smoke that I could hardly **breathe**. However, they can help him **breathe** with a machine. Don't **breathe** a word of this to my girlfriend.
english: to draw air in and out
arabicDesc: مثال: ملأ الدخان الغرفة حتى صعُب عليّ التنفس.

paragraph: He remained **calm** even in the presence of danger. It would be good for you to **calm** down. No matter what happens, you have to stay **calm**.
english: free from anger and anxiety

paragraph: Go to church with your parents and **pray** for her. You **prayed** that your children would forgive you. I hope you **prayed** for me.
english: to petition a higher being
arabicDesc: مثال: اذهب إلى الكنيسة مع والديك وصلّ لها.

paragraph: At this very moment, nearly 10,000 **Tweets** are being sent. How can your cat **tweet**? You are the latest three **tweets** that you posted.
english: the sound of a bird
arabicDesc: مثال: تُرسل حوالي عشرة آلاف تغريدة في هذه اللحظة.

other.meaning: To produce a short high-pitched sound, similar to that of certain birds (verb)

paragraph: Please consider that the **maximum** doesn't exist in some circumstances. The bus can carry a **maximum** of 40 people. She received the **maximum** sentence of ten years.
english: the largest amount possible or allowed

english: able and efficient
arabicDesc: مثال: هو قادر على تدريس كلاً من الإنجليزية والفرنسية.

paragraph: Does this look **familiar** to you? Why does that name sound **familiar**? I am **familiar** with this neighborhood.
english: known to one
arabicDesc: مثال: هل يبدو هذا مألوفا لك؟

english: responsible for a dishonest act
arabicDesc: مثال: واضح أنه مذنب.

paragraph: What we see depends **largely** on where we look. It turned out that my memory was **largely** correct. Climate change is **largely** caused by human activity.
english: mostly

paragraph: He was feeling **perfectly** fine when I examined him. The wedding ring fits **perfectly**. You know **perfectly** well that this won't lead anywhere.
english: with perfection
arabicDesc: مثال: كان يشعر على ما يرام عندما فحصته.

paragraph: Is your religion **relevant** throughout the whole Solar System? The time has come to debate the most **relevant** matters. Do you have a **relevant** point to make?
english: related, connected, or pertinent to a topic
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: متعلق

paragraph: He is **unable** to concentrate on his academic work. I'll be **unable** to make it to the meeting. I'm sorry I am **unable** to attend your party.
english: not able
arabicDesc: مثال: لا يمكنه التركيز على عمله الأكاديمي.

english: a state of being pleased
arabicDesc: مثال: شرّفنا التعامل معكم.

english: one appointed as the substitute of others, and empowered to act for them, in their name or their behalf
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: نائبة

english: a person who supports a team, person or idea

english: having the ability to create
arabicDesc: مثال: الأفكار المبدعة أصبحت قليلة للغاية مؤخّراً.

paragraph: This is a movie which combines education with **entertainment**. There was very little in the way of **entertainment**. Our estimate did not include food and **entertainment** expense.
english: a show put on for the enjoyment or amusement of others
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: تسلية، لهو، تفريح

english: dark image projected onto a surface
arabicDesc: مثال: كانت الفتاة خائفة من ظلها.

english: a long, thin piece of land
arabicDesc: مثال: هل سبق و أن قمتِ بعرض للتّعرّي؟

english: pitch of a word that distinguishes a difference in meaning
arabicDesc: مثال: لا تتكلّم بهذه النّبرة مع أبيك.

paragraph: The **province** supplies its neighbors with various raw materials. There is a smoke cloud over the **province**. We came here from the **province** where we both grew up.
english: a region of the earth or of a continent
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: مقاطعة

paragraph: The death **penalty** was done away with last year. If you make a mistake, you pay the **penalty**. There is to be no **penalty** without previous law.
english: a legal sentence

paragraph: He's not a **saint**. He just looks like one. You didn't hear me say that he's a **saint**. She would never do that. That woman is a **saint**.
english: a deceased person whom a church or another religious group has officially recognised as especially holy or godly
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: قديس

paragraph: She thinks that she's the center of the **universe**. Will we ever know the shape of the **universe**? She sees herself as the center of the **universe**.
english: the Universe
arabicDesc: مثال: هي تعتقد أنها مركز الكون.

paragraph: Police interviewed every single house owner in the **neighborhood**. Everyone in this **neighborhood** knows you are cheating on me. I don't know this **neighborhood** too well.
english: area near one's home
arabicDesc: مثال: استجوبت الشّرطة كلّ صاحب منزل في الحيّ.

paragraph: Remember to **log** out of your accounts when finished. Our boss wants us to maintain a calls **log**. Dad and Mom were able to **log** board this?
english: the trunk of a dead tree, cleared of branches

paragraph: I can't check my mail. The **server** is down. Obviously, the **server** load will increase as a result. Some mobile games open a new **server** every day.
english: a program that provides services to other programs or devices, either in the same computer or over a computer network
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: خادمة

paragraph: The actress made her **debut** when she was eight. Before their official **debut**, the two performed together many times. Her **debut** was the biggest social event of the season.
english: a first public appearance

paragraph: Everyone says I'm a **chip** off the old block. There was a single potato **chip** on each plate. Why don't we all **chip** in some money?
english: a small thin piece of something; also a computer part

paragraph: He was late to the **appointment** due to a traffic accident. Do you have an **appointment** with him? I was late for the **appointment**.
english: arrangement for a meeting; an engagement
arabicDesc: مثال: تأخر عن الموعد بسبب حادث سير.

other.meaning: act of appointing; designation of a person to hold an office
state of being appointed to a service or office; office to which one is appointed

paragraph: **Educational** reforms still have a long way to go. Pay will be based on experience and **educational** background. The current **educational** system is transforming students into robots.
english: of, or relating to education

paragraph: Most college students use computers **mainly** for writing papers. The party is **mainly** made up of working women. This castle was **mainly** built in the middle ages.
english: of a person or thing being the driving force influencing the outcome of an event

paragraph: Where did you **abandon** them? Why did you **abandon** me? Your patients won't **abandon** you.
english: to leave behind or desert; to forsake
arabicDesc: مثال: أين تركتهم؟

other.meaning: to give up control of, surrender

paragraph: Once you start a new game, you will enter the Character **Creation** screen. Can you work on content **creation** for marketing purposes? Scientific truth is a **creation** of the human mind.
english: something created such as an invention or artwork
arabicDesc: مثال: ستدخل شاشة «إنشاء الشخصية» متى بدأت لعبة جديدة.

paragraph: The dog is **blind** in one eye. Love is by nature **blind**. They say love is **blind**.
english: unable to see
arabicDesc: مثال: الكلب أعور.

other.meaning: To make temporarily or permanently blind (verb)

paragraph: Got your **gear** ready? Let's go fishing, my friend. What sort of **gear** do you like to wear? He's got all the **gear** and no idea.
english: equipment for an activity; also a part of an engine

paragraph: Who stole the **sheets** from the bed? Who is hiding under the **sheets**? Today there are many things made of **sheet** metal.
english: bedsheet
arabicDesc: مثال: من سرق الشراشف من السرير؟

paragraph: I want to become a **singer**. She wants to be a **singer**. She is a noted **singer**.
english: person who sings (male or generic term)
arabicDesc: مثال: أريد أن أصير مغنّيًا.

paragraph: He kept quiet. I thus **conclude** that he agrees. I have to **conclude** this deal within a week. We have to **conclude** that the policy is a failure.
english: to decide after thinking; to end

paragraph: What is the most powerful **prayer** in the world? He said each meeting should begin with a **prayer**. Even your silence can be a part of **prayer**.
english: a practice of communicating with one's God, or with some spiritual entity
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: دعاء، صلا، دعا

paragraph: You have brought **shame** upon our family. You **shamed** me at the station. The teacher literally body-**shamed** me.
english: reproach incurred or suffered; dishonour; ignominy; derision
arabicDesc: مثال: أنتَ جلبتَ العار علىَ عائلتنا.

paragraph: That cat needs help to **climb** off a table. You are not allowed to **climb** into his car. Your cat doesn't want to **climb** off my desk.
english: to ascend, to go up
arabicDesc: مثال: هذا القط يحتاج للمساعدة كي ينزل من الطاولة.

other.meaning: to mount, to move upwards on

paragraph: I attend an online English **academy** every Monday evening. She won an **Academy** Award for best supporting actress. His new movie earned him an **Academy** Award.
english: an institution for the study of higher learning
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: أكاديمية

paragraph: Do you have light in the **bathroom**? I'm going to be in the **bathroom**. I have to go to the **bathroom**.
english: a room with a bathtub
arabicDesc: مثال: هل لديك ضوء في الحمام؟

paragraph: My computer crashed and now it won't **boot** up. What's in that beach bag in your car **boot**? The **boot** is already full! What shall we do?
english: a heavy shoe that covers part of the leg
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: بسطار

paragraph: There is no hope of his **recovery**. Community is important to **recovery** from mental health conditions. There is little if any hope for his **recovery**.
english: return to normal health
arabicDesc: مثال: ليس هناك أمل بتعافيه.

other.meaning: act or process of regaining or repossession of something lost

paragraph: The last part of the **legend** was added later. The **legend** says he was abandoned in the woods. A **legend** is more powerful than the truth.
english: story of unknown origin describing plausible but extraordinary past events

other.meaning: key to the symbols and color codes on a map

paragraph: The **prisoners** looked at one another. The king ordered the **prisoner** should be set free. The **prisoner** is being quiet in the cell today.
english: a person incarcerated in a prison, while on trial or serving a sentence
arabicDesc: مثال: نظر السجناء إلى بعضهم البعض.
